translations.web: “But you profane it, in that you say, ‘Yahweh’s table is polluted, and its fruit, even its food, is contemptible.’
translations.bsb: “But you profane it when you say, ‘The table of the Lord is defiled, and as for its fruit, its food is contemptible.’
translations.kjv: But ye have profaned it, in that ye say, The table of the LORD is polluted; and the fruit thereof, even his meat, is contemptible.
translations.asv: But ye profane it, in that ye say, The table of Jehovah is polluted, and the fruit thereof, even its food, is contemptible.
